items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Fletcher Henderson did a week at the Louvre.

ctx.x: He was a very fine sax man and this Grant Williams was with him, and of course he got very well known by him being with this band here, and they had played this Louvre Ballroom. If you had ever played in there, that was really the best. Fletcher Henderson did a week at the Louvre.
